notes.title: New localisation update!
notes.notes:
Hello Full Void Community!

For all our players out there, we've got you covered! Full Void is now rolling out in even more languages. 🌍🎮

While Full Void immerses you in its adventure mainly through atmospheric storytelling and evocative sounds, we've now localized the achievements and the UI of the game.

[b]New Languages Available! 🌍[/b]
Based on your feedback, Full Void is now available in:

French 🇫🇷
Spanish 🇪🇸
Portuguese 🇵🇹🇧🇷
Turkish 🇹🇷

With this, Full Void now supports a total of 7 languages, including the previously available English 🇬🇧, German 🇩🇪, and Italian 🇮🇹. This ensures that more players can dive into the game with a familiar touch.

[b]Ready to Dive In?[/b]
Jump into the world of Full Void and let the pixels do the talking! Whether you're dodging obstacles or unraveling mysteries, it's all in a day's play. And now, it speaks your language. 😉

[b]We'd Love Your Feedback[/b]
If you have any comments about the new localizations or run into any issues, please reach out. We're here to help and ensure a smooth gaming experience for everyone.

[b]What's Next?[/b]
We're always looking to improve Full Void. In conclusion, we'd love to hear from you about which other languages you'd like to see the game translated into. Your input will guide our future updates.

Thank you for being a part of the Full Void community. Happy gaming!

Best wishes,
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: 🚀 Full Void physical release on Evercade – A Dream Come True! 🕹️🎉
notes.notes:
Dear Full Void Community,

We are absolutely thrilled to share some incredible news with all of you! Full Void is making its way to the Evercade!

If you're new to Evercade, this is a retro gaming system that uses physical cartridges to play games! They officially licence retro and new games and put them in cartridges to run on the Evercade VS Home Console and the Evercade handhelds. Each cartridge contains a collection of games that could be either of the same developer or from a gaming system or the arcade. You get your copy in a clamshell box complete with a manual. Very retro style!

That, until now. In fact, Full Void is going to be their first single game release!

For us, the journey to bring Full Void to Evercade has been nothing short of a dream come true. As game developers, there's an indescribable magic in holding a physical copy of our creation in our hands. And the Evercade, with its delightful retro charm, feels like the perfect match for Full Void.

We've poured our hearts into this game, carefully crafting a blend of nostalgia and innovation that we hope resonates with both our audiences. The overlap between Evercade enthusiasts and those who appreciate the depth we've put into Full Void is truly beautiful.

We want to thank Blaze for the opportunity and we are counting the days that separates us to the release in October.

In the meantime, Full Void's cartidges, both the regular and the special edition, are available to pre-order!
YES! You read it right! There's going to be a [b]SPECIAL EDITION[/b] where you'll find a delightful artbook and a comic that our artists made especially for the occasion to tell you more about the backstory of Full Void). 

If you enjoyed playing Full Void and you want to own a physical copy, to hold in your hands and collect, this is for you. But be mindfull that copies are selling fast! Here's is a link to Amazon. Until stock lasts.
[url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/Evercade-Full-Void-Special-Edition/dp/B0CDCLSQ95]Pre-order your copy of Full Void - Special Edition[/url]

And if you've missed out on the announcement, here's your chance to catch up!

[previewyoutube=IndRPsEgpgI;full][/previewyoutube]


Until next time,

The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: We are happy to announce the release of Full Void today
notes.notes:
Dear Full Void Gamers,

Today is the day we've all been waiting for - the launch of Full Void! 🚀 
We're thrilled to finally share this game with you and couldn't have done it without your incredible support.

First and foremost, we want to express our gratitude to our wonderful Steam community. Your invaluable insights, feedback, and constructive suggestions have been instrumental in polishing Full Void. We are forever thankful for your eagle eyes and your unwavering dedication.

The incredible number of wishlists gave us the confidence to push ahead, knowing we were on the right path. Thank you to everyone who played the demo and has been following us since our participation in the Steam Next Fest. Your support has been integral to our journey.

To our broader community who have cheered us on through social media - your likes, shares, and words of encouragement have truly buoyed our spirits throughout this journey. Your support reminds us why we love what we do.

To our beta testers - we are in awe of your commitment. You dove headfirst into Full Void and helped us fine-tune it with your comprehensive reports and observations. We are immensely grateful for your assistance.

Last but certainly not least, a huge thank you to everyone who visited our booth at WASD in London. It was an absolute pleasure to meet you, chat with you, and share our passion for gaming. We are going to go back in September and we sincerely hope to see at least as many of you there again!

We've poured our vision and passion into Full Void, and after two years of work, we're excited to share the final result with all of you. Thank you for believing in our idea, supporting our passion, and being part of this incredible journey. 

So, without further ado, let's dive into the dystopian world of Full Void!

Sincerely,

The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Release is one month away
notes.notes:
Dear players,

If only we could convey with words the amount of excitment pulsing through our office! 
After about two years of development, Full Void release date is getting close. On the 18th of July we will finally be able to share the whole game with you and we're eager to hear what you think.

Your feedback from the demo and the beta has been invaluable. We've put everything into making Full Void a memorable experience and are now in the process of perfecting the final details, including some new cut scene animations that we added during the beta and some audio that will add substantially to the experience.

As we approach the release date, we're also planning some special events to show our appreciation for your support. This will include a live Q&A with our developers and exclusive reveals. Stay tuned for more details on these events, and make sure you're following us on our social channels to get the latest updates.

Your enthusiasm and support for Full Void have been a constant source of motivation for us. We're excited for you to experience the game on July 18th.

Thank you for being part of this journey with us.

Best,
The OutOfTheBit Team

notes.title: Beta Release & A Big Thank You to Our Testers!
notes.notes:
Hello, Full Void Community!

We're thrilled to announce that the Full Void Beta is officially out! It's been a wild journey, full of hard work, innovation, and anticipation. Now, we're finally here, and we can't wait for our dedicated group of beta testers to dive into the game.

But before we go any further, we want to take a moment to extend a massive thank you to everyone who put themselves forward for beta testing. Your enthusiasm and support have been nothing short of incredible. And your feedback will help shape the final touches of the game.

We're eager to hear your thoughts.

And remember, the excitement doesn't end here. We're all pumped up for the official release of Full Void, which is just about a month away. So, stay tuned for more updates as we approach the big day.

Thank you once again, testers and supporters near and far.

Best,
The OutOfTheBit Team
